confidence_allocation.fine_model: delta/4 over the same fixed outgoing batches; union over rounds 1/((t+1)(t+2)); no independence from leak statistics needed

provenance_premise: Authentic iid transitions; every batch size, public partition and support fixed before its observations; norm probes independent after coarse matrix and partition lock.
scope: Ordinary sparse community proposal plus acquired two-sided certificate, with retained outgoing counts reused for fine action. Not a new clustering algorithm, no historical novelty or practical-advantage claim.

screening.MC_qualification: Hoeffding sufficient budgets, not lower bounds. A shared prefix rollout tree gives valid individual marginals and union confidence; it retains all work. Variance-aware adaptive MC may be cheaper.
screening.same_certificate_comparator: Ordinary retained community/spectral/Krylov/range code can use the same acquired certificate and gets the same admitted capability; certificate contribution is not erased by this.

history_sensitivity.proof: Both words have the same action multiset. Any count-only scalar predictor has worst error at least half their true spread.

fixture_source_scope: The driver sets hidden tau=.04; the acquire function sees only its ordinary forward interface and public task. Synthetic aggregate sampling, not billions of executed queries.
